payload.change: project_theseus 下新开 BridgeV3 HCI control-deck exploration：用户要求单独创建 bridgeV3 项目，探索融合 3D/game-space、HTML/canvas 信息屏、动态文字重排等最新交互技术，解决 Theseus cognition/observability/HCI 问题；本轮已创建 bridgeV3/ 可运行 TypeScript-first 原型，等待用户视觉与技术方向验收。

payload.raw: three.js和babylon.js有什么区别？ why not babylon.js？ 让这个页面可以用wasd操纵摄像机移动，鼠标转动相机

proposal.background: BridgeV3正在探索Theseus舰桥式3D HCI；用户要求解释Three.js与Babylon.js取舍，并把页面变成可操作的3D空间。
proposal.target_behavior: BridgeV3页面允许点击进入指针锁定，用WASD移动摄像机，用鼠标转动视角。
proposal.suggested_solution: 继续使用Three.js维护轻量、可控的HCI原型；采用Pointer Lock API和手写相机状态更新实现第一人称浏览。
proposal.acceptance: 构建通过；reflow测试通过；本地静态服务能加载dist/main.js和Three模块；用户可通过Tailscale访问并操作。
proposal.out_of_scope: 暂不切换到Babylon.js，不引入完整游戏引擎、物理系统或资产编辑器。
proposal.next: 把相机控制说明沉淀到BridgeV3文档，并在回复中解释技术取舍。

payload.display_title: 升级 BridgeV3 沉浸式星空舰桥
payload.summary: Removed visible side panel, fixed world-space board texture orientation, added in-world reflow actuator and R shortcut, added generated deep-space bridge backdrop asset, and documented Cerebras-inspired speed requirements in BridgeV3 requirements.

payload.display_title: 优化 BridgeV3 深空背景运行时资产
payload.summary: Kept generated PNG as source material and converted it to a lightweight WebP runtime backdrop for the Babylon.js exterior window, preserving immersion while reducing first-load asset weight.

payload.display_title: 强化 BridgeV3 360 深空舰桥氛围
payload.summary: Removed manual DynamicTexture vertical inversion, replaced baked cockpit backdrop with a cropped exterior window asset, added a procedural 360-degree deep-space dome with subtle motion, and documented the GSAP/R3F technology boundary for future exploration.
payload.visual_note: Local headless Chrome screenshot remained black because GL initialization failed in this environment; remote browser verification is needed for final visual judgment.

payload.display_title: 修复 BridgeV3 世界屏幕反向显示
payload.summary: Changed readable planes from double-sided backface rendering to explicit front-facing planes, removed manual DynamicTexture inversion, and cache-busted the runtime script and deep-space asset so the remote browser loads the corrected orientation.

payload.display_title: 修复 BridgeV3 主告示板上下镜像
payload.summary: Restored the main paper notice board to the first working geometry orientation: double-sided plane with only a slight X rotation and no Y-axis flip, then cache-busted the runtime script with a screen-upright version string.

payload.display_title: 修复 BridgeV3 DynamicTexture 上下倒置
payload.summary: Inspected the Taildrop screenshot and found every canvas-backed DynamicTexture text surface was upside down. Root cause was calling DynamicTexture.update(false); Babylon expects update(true) for canvas coordinates with y increasing downward. Updated the main notice board, procedural space dome texture, console labels, and reflow actuator label to update(true), then cache-busted the served runtime as dynamic-upright.

payload.display_title: 升级 BridgeV3 曲面观测主面板
payload.summary: Replaced the flat central notice plane with a true curved mesh dashboard surface, moved ASCII observability dashboard semantics into the main panel, and kept the starfield as spatial atmosphere rather than a single pasted backdrop. The panel now contains functions, watcher runtime, agent roster, L1/task/intent status, and service rail sections.

payload.display_title: 修复 BridgeV3 曲面屏和 reflow 标签贴面方向
payload.summary: User confirmed MEMORY/DRIVE labels are upright while the central curved dashboard and reflow actuator label remain reversed. Adjusted the custom curved mesh UV vertical coordinate separately from default Babylon planes and removed the Y-axis face flip from the reflow label, then cache-busted the runtime as curved-uv-face.

payload.display_title: 添加 BridgeV3 屏幕方向校准墙
payload.summary: Added eight numbered calibration screens with different combinations of flat/curved geometry, DynamicTexture.update(true/false), UV vertical direction, and front/back facing. Number plaques use the known-good MEMORY/DRIVE orientation so the user can identify which screen orientation is correct.

payload.display_title: 应用 BridgeV3 屏幕方向校准结果
payload.summary: User reported calibration screens 1, 5, and 8 were upright. Applied screen 5 to the central curved dashboard (update true, no V flip, front-facing curved mesh) and screen 1 to the flat reflow actuator label (update true, front-facing plane), then removed the calibration wall and cache-busted runtime as screen5-final.

payload.display_title: 修复 BridgeV3 主曲面屏左右镜像
